name: eventhive
description: EventHive: event discovery and ticketing (Express API in server/, Next.js app in client/)

scripts.setup: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: npm run dev --prefix server & npm run dev --prefix client & wait
scripts.check: npm run typecheck --prefix server && npm test --prefix server && npm run lint --prefix client && cd client && npx tsc --noEmit
